title: EP 26 — INSTALL A PLUGIN
sub: Add a marketplace, install a plugin, done
lines: A marketplace is a catalog of plugins someone shared
A marketplace is a catalog of plugins someone else shared.
Add the catalog: claude plugin marketplace add owner/repo
Step one. Claude plugin marketplace add, owner slash repo.
Step two. Claude plugin install, name at marketplace. Installs to user scope.
Both run as one-line CLI commands — no menu
